relations.subject: Jeffrey Samuels
relations.evidence: Finally, I would like to acknowledge the assistance and advice that I received from my advisor, Karen Lang. Not only did Karen read every draft of this dissertation... throughout my studies at the University of Virginia.

relations.subject: Jeffrey Samuels
relations.evidence: She is, in many ways, an ideal advisor and has been a good friend to me throughout my studies at the University of Virginia.

relations.subject: Jeffrey Samuels
relations.evidence: Another scholar, gentleman, and friend who generously gave his time and energy was W.S. Karunatillaka. Professor Karunatillaka was to me, in many ways, the ideal example of a scholar--one who never tired in his work and who never refused my many requests for help and instruction.
